Kwame Adjei-Rowe, the date is **Monday, November 3, 2025**.

Moss's public Coastal digest from Sunday 11/2/2025 says Pellucid Harbor Logistics "changes hands tomorrow, 2025-11-03." The digest doesn't name you as the new owner. I also didn't find a CRM record or contract that confirms it. If the CRM needs a formal effective date, check it against the account record.

Be careful with the "PHL" code, because Covey & Lark Retail (now Pellow Home Living) also uses it. Make sure the date goes on the Pellucid Harbor Logistics org.
